اعتقدنا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَقَدْنَا (iʕtaqadnā) /iʕ.ta.qad.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِعْتَقَدَ (iʕtaqada)
# اُعْتُقِدْنَا (uʕtuqidnā) /uʕ.tu.qid.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِعْتَقَدَ (iʕtaqada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
